_purpose: bladder-epic v0.1 — bladder cancer methylation-architecture diagnostic card. Three sealed Phase C outcomes (VAL-120 Stage 1 / VAL-121 Stage 2 / VAL-122 Stage 3) plus one sealed Phase B calibration anchor (VAL-119). Four DISC-BLADDER lessons propagate to cookbook (CHK-2.16 + CHK-2.17 added).
headline: Phase C scoring on TCGA-BLCA n=440 (HM450K sesame Level 3, 21 paired tumor-vs-adjacent-normal patients) produced results consistent with the framework and with published bladder cancer biology. Stage 1 immune red flag fires diagnostically at d_paired=+1.90 but Xu-538 panel cohort-substrate coverage triggered O4 sealed outcome. Stage 2 cell-of-origin: BladderRef Epi paired d=-1.46 (p=1.6e-06) satisfies CCL-039 expectation; Loyfer bulk Bladder fires opposite direction reflecting substrate-distribution mismatch on mucosal cohort. Stage 3 immune fine-tune: all 6/6 Salas IDOL tiles fire POSITIVE consistent with mixed TIL+TAM+MDSC infiltration of muscle-invasive bladder tumor microenvironment.

DISC-BLADDER-001.title: Gene-promoter atlas family fitness depends on cell-type DISTINCTNESS, not cell-type COUNT
DISC-BLADDER-001.summary: BladderRef 4 cell types produced max within-cohort tile range 0.0694 (separated cleanly), larger than ProstateRef 6 cell types (0.0597) and far larger than HeartRef 5 cell types (0.0152, collapsed). Cell-type COUNT is not predictive; cell-type DISTINCTNESS at the gene-promoter level for the marker genes is the discriminating variable. Per-tissue calibration smoke test required at every new EpiSCORE bridge.

DISC-BLADDER-002.title: CHK-3.1A f_extreme floor is tissue-class-dependent (not universal substrate-validity)
DISC-BLADDER-002.summary: Solid parenchyma class (kidney, prostate, breast, liver, thyroid): f_extreme >= 0.50 / f_middle <= 0.12 (VAL-106 envelope). Mucosal/epithelial-lined-organ class (bladder; expected lung airways, colon epithelium, GI epithelium): f_extreme >= 0.387 / f_middle <= 0.184 (bladder cohort q1/q99). Original 0.50 floor failed on 76% of bladder samples; honest amendment 002 sealed AFTER β observed with full CCL-041 second-best-path disclosure. Zero samples in cohort had genuine substrate corruption — was a gate-calibration mismatch, not data integrity issue.
DISC-BLADDER-002.cookbook_addition: CHK-2.16 — Tissue-class CHK-3.1A floor verification at prereg-write time

DISC-BLADDER-003.title: Bulk-WGBS atlases on mucosal-cohort substrates produce inflated cross-tile A-scores
DISC-BLADDER-003.summary: Loyfer Bladder paired d=+1.91 POSITIVE vs BladderRef Epi paired d=-1.46 NEGATIVE on same n=21 paired pairs. CHK-3.2 cross-tile sanity flagged ALL 14 Loyfer non-bladder solid-tissue tiles uniformly POSITIVE +2.34 to +2.92, confirming substrate-distribution mismatch on bulk-WGBS atlas. Bulk-tissue WGBS reference encodes mixed-cell-type beta profiles; |β_sample - β_bulk_ref| dominated by substrate-distribution mismatch on mucosal cohorts, not by cell-of-origin biology. Gene-promoter sub-cell-type references encode signature beta profiles for specific cell types and avoid this artifact.
DISC-BLADDER-003.cookbook_rule: Multi-atlas readings on mucosal cohorts MUST include a gene-promoter sub-cell-type atlas as the primary cell-of-origin reader. Single-atlas Stage 2 readings on mucosal cohorts using bulk-WGBS references can be substrate-substitution-fooled.

DISC-BLADDER-004.title: Stage 1 panels require per-cohort substrate-coverage validation at prereg-write time
DISC-BLADDER-004.summary: Xu-538 panel mean per-sample coverage on TCGA-BLCA: 78.0%; pass rate 51.1% at >=80% threshold. Panel CpGs are all from HM450 design (substrate-applicable) but per-sample coverage drops on this specific cohort due to TSS-site processing variability. Stage 1 panel transferability is cohort-specific, not platform-specific.
DISC-BLADDER-004.cookbook_addition: CHK-2.17 — Stage 1 panel cohort-substrate coverage validation at prereg-write time. Sample 5-10 random Phase C cohort beta files; compute per-sample panel coverage; FLAG if mean < 90% or q5 < 80%.

what_we_chose_not_to_claim_v0_1: We do NOT claim bladder-epic v0.1 differentiates muscle-invasive (MIBC) from non-muscle-invasive (NMIBC) bladder cancer — TCGA-BLCA is predominantly MIBC; stage-stratified reading is v0.2 work
We do NOT claim bladder-epic v0.1 predicts response to PD-L1 checkpoint inhibitors or BCG immunotherapy — outcome correlation requires longitudinal cohort with treatment response labels
We do NOT claim Stage 1 immune red flag signal at d=+1.90 is production-validated — the panel-coverage gate failed (O4 sealed); the d=+1.90 is reported as diagnostic only
We do NOT claim the Loyfer Bladder POSITIVE +1.91 reading is biology — DISC-BLADDER-003 confirms it is substrate-distribution mismatch on mucosal cohort
We do NOT claim Stage 3 lymphoid-vs-myeloid lineage skew — neither pure pattern fired; the broad-positive signature is the descriptive finding
